origin: board centre, PCB top surface at z = 0, +Y towards the USB edge

layers.name: base
layers.purpose: Bottom. Hex pockets hold the M3 nuts; the small hole reaches the reset button.

layers.name: bottom-frame
layers.purpose: Ring around the underside parts. Frosted acrylic spreads the underglow.

layers.name: top-frame
layers.purpose: Spacer between PCB and plate; sets the switch height.

layers.name: plate
layers.purpose: Switch plate. Top surface is 5.0 mm above the PCB, the Cherry MX seating height.
